text:
Hi there, and thanks so much for contacting Leafy! 🌿

A Plant Care Specialist reviews Plant Care Guarantee claims within **2 business days**.

Here's how to get your claim started:
- Go to "My Orders" and submit your claim within your guarantee window (30 days from delivery, or 90 days for Leafy Plus members).
- Include at least **two photos**: one of the whole plant and one close-up.
- You don't need to send the plant back.

If your claim is approved, we send one free replacement of the same plant (or store credit if it's out of stock).

Is there a plant you're worried about right now? I'm happy to help with next steps, and our Plant Care Specialists also offer free care advice by chat (9am-5pm Mon-Fri) if you'd like some tips in the meantime. Please reach out any time! 🌱
